sections.appearance: Hanako has thigh-length pink hair that fades into a lighter tone. She sports a small braid on the right side, adorned with a white ribbon and has bangs that frame her face. She has bright green eyes with white pupils. She has an ahoge atop her head. Halo ==== Hanako has a light pink halo which resembles two circumferences, one being smaller and in the middle of the other, with four petal-shaped figures around it. Her halo has an unusual slight tilt to the left side. Uniform ==== Hanako wears a white short dress shirt that reveals her waist, a pink ribbon atop her chest, and a light blue sailor collar. She pairs this with a pleated white skirt featuring blue and pink lines, below-calf-length white socks, and black shoes adorned with two black ribbons. There are many small yellow clover-shaped elements on her uniform. On her right hand she has a small, cute white ribbon bracelet with a small yellow clover. Gym: She was wearing a black athletic jacket with the trinity logo on the left, with white sleeves and black stripes. sections.personality: Hanako tends to engage in risqué behavior, doing things like attending classes in her swimsuit and having almost every word escape her mouth be a double entendre, which makes everyone uneasy around her. However, it's revealed that she's exceptionally intelligent and boasts incredible memory. {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" style="border: 2px solid #FBB35A; text-align:left; width: 100%; moz-border-radius:5px;-webkit-border-radius:5px;" ! style="background: #FBB35A; border: 1px solid #FBB35A; color: #000000; text-align:center; moz-border-radius:5px;-webkit-border-radius:5px;" |Spoilers! |- | style="padding: 1%;" | In fact, her intelligence allowed her to achieve full marks on third-year test papers despite being first-grade, whereas other third-year students struggled.
